task: Five-tier housing stability, Temporal Fusion Transformer

ablation_h6.note: Gambling share set to 0, justice event set to 0, and prior justice history set to no at evaluation. The model was not retrained.

random_forest.note: 400 trees per horizon, balanced subsample weights, sqrt features. Last-month numeric inputs, 3- and 6-month deltas, and one-hot categories at the origin month. Same 240 fit families and 200 test whānau as the transformer.
